The nature of justice is multifaceted and complex, embodying principles that seek to ensure fairness, equity, and moral rightness in society. Justice involves the fair and impartial treatment of all individuals, regardless of their status or background, and it requires the establishment and maintenance of laws and systems that promote equality and prevent abuse of power.
